name: Solid sheesham wood wall key holder, 6 hooks (plain/honey finish)
supplier_cost_note: IndiaMART Saharanpur directory (dir.indiamart.com/saharanpur/wooden-key-holder.html, search snippet seen 2026-10-23): Fantasy Living wall-mount sheesham key holder, 6 hooks, Rs 170/piece; Teak Wood Big Gem Stone sheesham wall key holder, 4 hooks, Rs 185/piece; Tamanna Handicrafts sheesham key stand, 5 hooks, Rs 85/piece. Village Handicraft Company wooden key holder with hooks Rs 130/piece excl. taxes (wood type not stated). Many Saharanpur listings carry MOQs of 100+; MOQ, GST treatment and drop-ship willingness for the Rs 170 item not shown. No Odisha supplier found. Pages not opened directly (proxy blocks indiamart).
retail_observed: Amazon.in (search snippets 2026-10-23): GM CRAFT solid sheesham key stand, 7 hooks, honey finish Rs 749 (MRP 1,999), 4.6 stars from 59 ratings, '100+ bought in past month'. Woodenstreet sheesham 6-hook key holders Rs 999-1,499 (Tree of Life Rs 1,499 less 12%). GKW Retail sheesham owl 6-hook Rs 3,499. Cheaper non-sheesham competition: Kuber Industries MDF 9-hook with shelf Rs 348, Capio Art wooden with shelf Rs 249, WOXOUR MDF 7-hook Rs 184, handcrafted MDF 8-hook Rs 219. Rs 599 undercuts the cheapest sheesham comparable (Rs 749) but is well above MDF versions.

demand_signals.summary: GM CRAFT solid sheesham 7-hook key stand Rs 749 shows '100+ bought in past month' and 4.6 stars (59 ratings); MDF key holders show 100-200+ bought in past month at Rs 249-348. Snapshot dates of the cached snippets are unknown.
Branded furniture retailer carries several sheesham 6-hook key holders at Rs 999-1,499 (price evidence, no volume data)

risks: Supplier price is a directory snippet with no MOQ or GST info; get a written quote for the exact 6-hook piece with dimensions, hook material and photos with permission
Genuine sheesham claim needs supplier written confirmation (many listings are mango wood or MDF)
Most buyers pick Rs 184-348 MDF key holders; Rs 599 relies on the solid-wood positioning
UP supplier: GST bill-to-ship-to limits it to the website unless an Odisha stockist is found
Wall-fixing screws/plugs must be included; hook loosening or wood cracks in transit cause returns
Packed weight unknown; le_1kg assumed (likely under 500 g)
GST: HSN 4420 wooden articles assumed 12% (may be 5% after the 22-09-2025 rate change); CA to confirm

review.notes: The UP (Saharanpur) supplier means website-only via bill-to-ship-to, and there the margin engine gives 28.8% at the Rs 170 snippet cost (le_1kg, 12% GST). It reaches 30% only at about Rs 160-165 (Rs 160 gives 30.8%, Rs 150 gives 32.7%), or at Rs 170 if the packed weight is 500 g or less (32.9%) or the CA confirms 5% GST on HSN 4420 after 22-09-2025 (33.3%). Rs 599 is below verified sheesham 6-hook prices (Vibecity Rs 879, Woodenstreet Rs 999, Pepperfry Rs 1,030); I could not re-verify GM CRAFT's Rs 749 because Amazon.in was unreachable. Before buying a sample, get a written quote at Rs 150-160 or less from an Odisha stockist or this supplier. It must state genuine solid sheesham (not mango wood or MDF) and 6 screwed metal hooks, include screws and wall plugs, and give the packed weight, MOQ (Saharanpur wholesale lists show 500-piece MOQs, e.g. Fine Handicrafts at Rs 110-200), GST invoice terms and willingness to drop-ship, plus photos with permission.

evidence_checked.complaint_patterns: No sheesham-specific complaints found. Generic wooden key holder reviews mention hooks shipped unassembled, broken hooks and weak plastic anchors (https://www.walmart.com/ip/Gone-Fishing-Coat-Rack-Wall-Mount-Wood-Key-Holder-Wall-11-8-7-9inch-Black-Fish-Key-Rack-Hangers-5-Alloy-Hooks-Wall-Art-Decor-Entryway-Front-Door-Fish/6440261534). Cheap 'wooden' Meesho 6-hook listings do not state the wood type (https://www.meesho.com/shivmaan-art-wooden-wall-mounted-designer-key-holders-6-hooks/p/6rbslb).
evidence_checked.gst: Secondary sources show HSN 4420 moved from 12% to 5% from 22-09-2025, with 5% conditional on the goods being handmade handicraft (https://taxguru.in/goods-and-service-tax/rajasthan-aar-5-percent-gst-handicraft-job-work-subject-conditions.html, https://disytax.com/hsn-chapter-44-wood-articles-gst/). CA to confirm; gst_pct is left at 12%.
evidence_checked.supplier_cost: The Rs 170 IndiaMART snippet could not be opened. Another Saharanpur lead, Fine Handicrafts, lists wooden key holders at Rs 110-200 with MOQ 500, wood type and hook count not stated (https://www.exportersindia.com/finehandicrafts/keychain.htm).
